The '''TranLang I Communication module''' was a droid communications module that stored around five hundred thousand forms of communication.

Its successors were the [[TranLang II communications module/Legends|TranLang II Communication module]] and [[TranLang III communications module/Legends|TranLang III communications module]]. It was installed in droids such as the [[BT-16 perimeter droid]].<ref name="GG7" />
